description: Fix post-sampling system RAM crash on Colab T4 by: (1) unloading DiT/base_model and upscaler BEFORE VAE decode, (2) adding frame-streaming decode_video_latent that decodes in sub-batches and pipes frames directly to ffmpeg without holding full frame tensor in RAM, (3) rewriting _write_chunk_via_ffmpeg to accept frames one-at-a-time (streaming) instead of converting the entire tensor to numpy at once, (4) adding RAM safety checks before decode operations, (5) adding a cpu_ram_cleanup helper to the LTXMemoryManager class.
steps: Step 1 - Add RAM safety method to LTXMemoryManager (SECTION 3, around line 450-600): Add `is_ram_safe(self, required_gb: float = 2.0) -> bool` that returns True if cpu_available_gb() > required_gb. Add `ram_cleanup(self)` that calls gc.collect() repeatedly and logs RAM state. Add `estimate_frame_ram_gb(self, num_frames: int, height: int, width: int) -> float` that calculates expected RAM for decoded frames (num_frames * height * width * 3 * 4 / 1024^3 for float32).

Step 2 - Modify generate_chunk() (SECTION 18, around line 2160-2395) to unload DiT/base_model and upscaler BEFORE VAE decode: After sampling pass 2 completes and sample_out_2 is obtained (after the existing `del latent_for_sampler2, model_g2, dit_model`), add explicit unloading of base_model (if it's not the same object already deleted as dit_model) using `del base_model` followed by `mem.aggressive_cleanup()`. The upscaler is already deleted at step 12 (`del lat_crop55, upscaler`) which is fine. Also add `del dir_model, dir_guide_data, dir_motion_guide_data, dir_positive, dir_video_latent, dir_audio_latent` after they are no longer needed (after Guide pass 2, step 13) to free any references the director holds.

Step 3 - Rewrite _write_chunk_via_ffmpeg (SECTION 17, line 2056) to do STREAMING frame-by-frame conversion instead of bulk numpy conversion: Instead of `frames_np = (frames_cpu.clamp(0,1) * 255).byte().numpy()` which creates a full copy, iterate frame-by-frame: for each frame index i, convert only frames_cpu[i] to numpy bytes and write to pipe, then delete the frame reference. This eliminates the RAM doubling.

Step 4 - Rewrite decode_video_latent (SECTION 16, line 1944) to support sub-batch decoding when RAM is low: Add a parameter `max_batch_frames: int = 0` (0 means decode all at once as before). When the estimated frame RAM exceeds available RAM minus 2GB headroom, split the latent along the temporal dimension and decode in sub-batches (e.g., 8 frames at a time), concatenating results on CPU. This prevents a single massive CPU allocation.

Step 5 - Modify save_chunk_to_disk (SECTION 17, line 1992) to pass frames directly to _write_chunk_via_ffmpeg in streaming mode rather than trying the CreateVideo node first (since CreateVideo may also buffer all frames). Add a CONFIG option 'prefer_streaming_save' defaulting to True that bypasses CreateVideo when RAM is low (cpu_available_gb < 4.0).

Step 6 - In generate_chunk() between steps 17-18 (after CropGuides, before decode), add a RAM check and aggressive cleanup: call `mem.ram_cleanup()`, print available RAM, and if available RAM < 3GB, log a warning. Also ensure all conditioning tensors from the sampling passes (pos_g2, neg_g2, etc.) are fully deleted before decode starts - verify the existing `del pos_g2, neg_g2, final_video_lat, pos_crop54, neg_crop54` is present and add `mem.aggressive_cleanup()` after it.
acceptance_criteria: The file parses without syntax errors (ast.parse succeeds)
DiT model (dit_model/base_model) is explicitly deleted and cleaned up BEFORE decode_video_latent is called in generate_chunk
All director-related tensors (dir_model, dir_guide_data, dir_motion_guide_data, dir_positive, dir_video_latent, dir_audio_latent) are deleted before decode
_write_chunk_via_ffmpeg converts frames one-at-a-time (no bulk .numpy() call on the full N-frame tensor)
decode_video_latent has sub-batch support for low-RAM situations
LTXMemoryManager has is_ram_safe(), ram_cleanup(), and estimate_frame_ram_gb() methods
save_chunk_to_disk skips CreateVideo when RAM is low, going straight to streaming ffmpeg
An aggressive_cleanup() call exists between the last sampling del and the decode_video_latent call
verification: Grep for the streaming frame loop in _write_chunk_via_ffmpeg to confirm no bulk numpy conversion
Grep for del base_model or del dit_model before decode_video_latent in generate_chunk
Grep for is_ram_safe or ram_cleanup to confirm new methods exist
findings: All 6 steps implemented successfully. AST parse passes. The file uses NameError try/except for safe deletion of variables (dir_positive, dir_video_latent, dir_audio_latent, base_model) that may have already been consumed by earlier assignments. Sub-batch decode uses temporal_compression=8 assumption for LTX model. The save_chunk_to_disk CreateVideo block was re-indented to fit under the new ram_too_low guard.
